prompts.prompt: Clean up this SIX-frame south/front-facing walk animation strip for a small game sprite. Preserve exactly six poses in one horizontal row and the character design. Make the SAME head/face/collar and torso width in every frame: visually copy the first head/chest rather than redesigning them. Small fixed palette and clean broad pixel clusters, remove granular noisy highlight texture and stray pixels. Smooth six-phase gait: screen-left boot contact, passing, rise, screen-right boot contact, passing, rise; opposing relaxed arm swing. Both lead feet must be represented. Keep arms near body, consistent limb lengths, minimal torso bob. Brown beard/hair, charcoal pressure suit, dark muted red shoulders; cyan chest lamp on image LEFT, button panel on image RIGHT. Slightly elevated front view. Full body with identical scale, wide equal gutters. Transparent background, no shadows, text, labels, scenery. Landscape 3:1.

Precise cleanup of SIX-frame walk strip (reference1); reference2 is the character design to preserve. Retain all costume construction: twin vertical harness straps, square throat clasp, segmented belt, oxblood shoulder plates, grey kneepads, chest cyan indicator LEFT and button block RIGHT. Do NOT simplify away the harness or change proportions. Only improve temporal consistency: identical face, hair, beard, head width, torso width and fixed chest hardware every frame. Smooth opposing arm swing and alternating left/right planted feet in a six-phase front-facing walk. Frame4 must have screen-LEFT boot forward, opposite to frame1. Keep reference pixel-art surface character but remove isolated noisy highlights. All six full bodies in one evenly spaced row, same scale/baseline, transparent background, no shadow/text/scene. Landscape 3:1.

Clean up the six EAST/right-facing WALK frames in reference1 while strictly retaining reference2's Major Bill costume and proportions. ONE row of SIX poses. Temporal consistency: identical head/beard/hair outline, collar, harness and back unit in all six; the torso should behave like a stable rigid form. Keep twin harness straps, oxblood shoulder plate, rectangular back unit, gloves and segmented boots. Smooth six-phase alternating walk with opposite arm swing, two distinct lead legs and restrained vertical bob. Legs pass naturally between contacts; frame6 flows into frame1. Preserve detailed pixel-art style but remove tiny noisy speckles, no redesign or simplified jumpsuit. Same full-body scale, equal spacing, wide gutters. SOLID MAGENTA #FF00FF background, not checkerboard, no shadows/text/scenery. Landscape 3:1.

Temporal cleanup of Major Bill's SIX WEST/left-facing walk poses. One row of six full-body frames. Keep reference pose sequence and exactly the same left-facing officer costume, segmented grey boots, knee plates, charcoal suit, red shoulder, chest button block, harness and backpack. Make head/beard/hair/collar dimensions identical frame to frame, stable torso and smoother arm swing with two alternating strides. Do not exaggerate motion. Keep same detailed pixel art surface style but consistent broad highlights instead of changing noise. Complete bodies, same scale and baseline, wide equal gutters. Solid magenta #FF00FF background; no shadows/text/checkerboard/scenery. Landscape 3:1.

Clean temporal consistency in this six-frame NORTH/BACK walk animation. Keep EXACTLY six full-body poses in ONE horizontal row. Preserve Major Bill's charcoal pressure suit, oxblood shoulder patches, rectangular rear unit and segmented grey boots. Identical hair outline, neck/collar, rear-unit dimensions and torso width across poses; no flickering highlights or changing panel seams. Refine alternating foot contacts and smooth opposite arm swing, restrained bob. Keep existing detailed pixel-art identity, do not redesign outfit. Equal scale and spacing, generous gaps, same baseline. Solid magenta #FF00FF background, no text/shadows/scenery. Landscape 3:1.

Clean up this SIX-frame SOUTH/front run loop of Major Bill. Keep six poses in one row, same stocky pressure-suited officer, harness straps, throat clasp, oxblood shoulders, cyan chest light on image left, button panel on right, gloves/boots. Lock head face hair beard and chest hardware across all frames. Refine this six-frame EAST/right-facing RUN cycle without replacing the poses. Preserve the six distinct leg/arm configurations exactly, including passing and airborne frames. Keep posture slightly leaning, not stretched taller than standing Bill in reference2. Preserve detailed charcoal suit, twin harness, red shoulder patch, grey boots/kneepads, cyan chest detail. Clean repeatable pixel highlights, no added noise. Exactly six whole-body poses in one row, same scale, generous equal spacing, magenta #FF00FF background, no labels/shadows/scenery. Landscape 3:1.

Refine six WEST/left-facing RUN frames from reference1. Retain all six distinct original motion poses and their order, don't generate repeated identical steps. Polish this SIX-frame kneeling repair loop. Major Bill remains in the exact same RIGHT-facing kneel: one knee on ground and one boot forward, torso/face/head/backpack absolutely stable. Right hand holds same short grey spanner in every frame.
